text.en:
Grants an additional Grenade Ability Charge.

Your <strand/>Grapple leaves behind a <strand/>'Grapple Tangle' on its point of impact, allowing for repeated use of <strand/>Grapple. The Grapple Tangle will not be created if it attaches to an enemy or ally.

Dealing damage with a <strand/>Grapple Melee Hit (inconsistently) creates a <strand/>Grapple Tangle, which rises into the air for future use. The Grapple Tangle will only be created if the <strand/>Grapple used was not previously refunded by attaching to a <strand/>Tangle or <strand/>Grapple Tangle.
